desc: Sort all edges by weight and build the Kruskal tree using a DSU: for each edge that connects two different components, create a new internal node with the edge weight and link it to the two component roots.

Perform an iterative post-order traversal of the tree. For each leaf, set its delta = count in A minus count in B. For each internal node, compute the total positive and negative surplus from its children, match min(pos, neg) pairs at cost = node weight, and propagate the remaining surplus to the parent.
Sum the costs from all internal nodes and output the result.
Write the Python program with the described algorithm, using DSU, Kruskal tree, and post-order traversal; ensure efficient I/O and handle large constraints; test on the given samples.
